mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INQUIRY i JOIN MEMBER m ON i.MEMBER_ID = m.MEMBER_ID WHERE i.PARENT_INQUIRY_ID IS NULL

SELECT i.INQUIRY_ID AS inquiryId, i.INQUIRY_TYPE AS inquiryType, i.TITLE AS title, i.STATUS AS status, m.NAME AS userName, m.LOGIN_ID AS loginId, TO_CHAR(i.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS createdAt FROM INQUIRY i JOIN MEMBER m ON i.MEMBER_ID = m.MEMBER_ID WHERE i.PARENT_INQUIRY_ID IS NULL
ORDER BY i.STATUS ASC, i.INQUIRY_ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH FIRST #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT i.INQUIRY_ID AS inquiryId, i.MEMBER_ID AS memberId, m.NAME AS userName, m.LOGIN_ID AS loginId, i.INQUIRY_TYPE AS inquiryType, i.TITLE AS title, i.CONTENT AS content, i.STATUS AS status, i.ANSWER_CONTENT AS answerContent, TO_CHAR(i.ANSWERED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS answeredAt, TO_CHAR(i.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS createdAt, i.PARENT_INQUIRY_ID AS parentInquiryId FROM INQUIRY i JOIN MEMBER m ON i.MEMBER_ID = m.MEMBER_ID WHERE i.INQUIRY_ID = #{inquiryId}

SELECT i.INQUIRY_ID AS inquiryId, i.TITLE AS title, i.CONTENT AS content, i.STATUS AS status, i.ANSWER_CONTENT AS answerContent, TO_CHAR(i.ANSWERED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS answeredAt, TO_CHAR(i.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS createdAt FROM INQUIRY i WHERE i.PARENT_INQUIRY_ID = #{parentId} ORDER BY i.CREATED_AT ASC
SELECT INQUIRY_FILE_ID AS inquiryFileId, INQUIRY_ID AS inquiryId, ORIGINAL_FILE_NAME AS originalFileName, FILE_PATH AS filePath FROM INQUIRY_FILE WHERE INQUIRY_ID = #{inquiryId}
mapper.update: UPDATE INQUIRY SET ANSWER_CONTENT = #{answerContent}, ANSWER_ADMIN_ID = #{answerAdminId}, ANSWERED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP, STATUS = 1 WHERE INQUIRY_ID = #{inquiryId}
